s17_f_neg.see: 核对过属实：背影，他右肩（画面右边）袖子垂下、下面那条拿骨钩的胳膊从这只肩出来，往上伸向狼嘴的那条胳膊也从同一只右肩的袖口后头冒出来，左肩埋在头发里看不见，一边肩长两条胳膊。缝成狗咬形的袖子在哪一边照口径不改；背上骨枝没接进狼脊，不抠。
s17_f_neg.keep: the same composition and low camera from behind, the tall pale demon man in the left foreground seen from behind with long indigo hair streaming to the left and two pale bone horns, the bloody white bone branches splitting out of his bare back, the stitched sleeve on the shoulder at the right, his lowered arm at the right gripping the long white bone hook wound with frayed rope, the giant iron-and-bone wolf rearing on the right with its glowing red chest cage and fanned white spines, the clockwork soldiers with winding keys hauling on the spines, the floating scaffold camp, the iron flowers, the blue light streaks, the colours, rendering and finish.
s17_f_neg.change: his raised arm reaching up toward the wolf in the upper middle of the picture. In the attached picture that raised arm comes out from behind the same right shoulder (the shoulder on the right side of the picture, with the hanging stitched sleeve) as the lowered arm holding the bone hook, so one shoulder has two arms. Make the raised arm clearly his LEFT arm: it starts from his left shoulder on the left side of his back, which shows as a bare pale shoulder just under the hanging indigo hair on the left, the upper arm rising up and forward past the left side of his head, the forearm reaching up and to the right toward the wolf's lowered muzzle with the same open pale hand and five spread fingers in the same place in the sky. The right shoulder at the right keeps only one arm, the lowered one with the stitched sleeve holding the bone hook; nothing else comes out of that shoulder.

s17_f_sevran.see: 核对过：右上影魔那条烟臂腕口有断面，爪手整只断开、和断腕隔着一截飘在空中。场面稿写的是 its hand gone at the wrist，就是这只手被斩断了，画成断手刚飞离断腕的那一下，读得出是斩断，不算毛病。脚下影子偏大，不抠。

s18_f_timo.see: 核对过属实：城墙顶上那一道白脚印连成的光拱（场面稿的主画面）没画，只有她前脚下空中一枚发光的脚印；头发画成长长的桃色辫子，场面稿和主会话定的是桃色短发。墙上狮子旗、腰间铃铛没裹布，不抠。
s18_f_timo.keep: the same composition and low camera, the rabbit-eared girl leaping high across the middle of the picture from the wall toward the right, arms flung forward, mouth open in a shout, her long rabbit ears flattened back, her torn teal cloak, red scarf, satchel and brass bell, her bloodied boots, the glowing footprint under her front foot, the cracked white stone city wall and gate on the left with its towers and banners, the stretcher-bearers carrying the wounded up the dark slope toward us, the bandaged woman and the old soldier with the box on his back in the right foreground, the white fire streaming down from the sky, the colours, rendering and finish.
s18_f_timo.change: Two things. First, along the top of the city wall on the left half of the picture: in the attached picture nothing is there but sky and falling fire. Add a long chain of glowing milky-white footprints hanging in the empty air step after step, running along above the battlements high over the whole length of the wall, about ten times a man's height above them, joined edge to edge into one tall, flat-topped, straight-edged bridge of soft white light; the white fire pouring down from the sky lands on top of this bridge and spreads along it instead of falling onto the wall and gate. The stretcher-bearers and the gate stay visible underneath it. Second, her hair: in the attached picture she has a long peach braid hanging down her back. Change it to short peach-coloured hair, a messy short cut ending above her jaw and the nape of her neck, blown back by the wind, with no braid and no long strands; her face, ears and expression stay the same.

s18_f_leonora.see: 核对过属实：前景担架兵的白罩袍胸前是金色十字，最前左边那一个、当中背影那一个都很清楚，右边远一点戴头巾的老兵胸前是红十字。另外她的领口是一圈立领加小搭扣，像中式立领盘扣，照口径一起改。头发披散不盘，照口径不改。
s18_f_leonora.keep: the same composition and low camera, the woman with long cobalt-blue hair and goggles on her forehead standing high in the open chest of the fallen colossal armoured machine, both arms raised and palms open to the sky, mouth open in a long call, blood on her face and hands, the huge glowing blue ring of rune-lines behind her holding back the white light, the cracked engraved armour plates with griffin reliefs all around, the line of stretcher-bearers hurrying past in the lower foreground, the distant grey rampart with gates on the right horizon, the colours, rendering and finish.
s18_f_leonora.change: Two things. First, the stretcher-bearers in the lower foreground: in the attached picture the white tabards on their chests carry crosses, a gold cross on the man at the far left, a gold cross on the man seen from behind in the middle, a red cross on the bandaged old man further right, and more on the small figures behind. Remove every cross: their tabards are plain off-white cloth with only blood stains and dirt, no emblem at all. Second, her collar: in the attached picture she wears a small stand-up mandarin-style collar fastened with little knotted clasps. Replace it with a plain turned-down shirt collar open at the throat, a simple western shirt collar with no clasps and no buttons showing; the rest of her torn coat stays as it is.

s19_f_tiloshan.see: 核对过属实：画面左中、她脚下栏杆外那面蓝旗上的金色纹章是一根竖杆加一道横梁、底下分叉，像十字架；右边那面是三叉戟，没问题。
s19_f_tiloshan.keep: the same composition and low camera, the siren woman standing on the gallery of the burning lighthouse on the right, one arm flung out toward the departing ships, her head back, mouth open in song, long blue-green hair braided with shell beads streaming to the left, the conch shell at her hip, the bleeding scales on her neck, the white-hot melting lamp top, the coral rocks and the other singers below with their faces raised, the line of sailing ships riding the glowing blue tide on the left, the boundless red sky with falling fire, the right-hand banner with its gold trident, the colours, rendering and finish.
s19_f_tiloshan.change: the torn blue banner hanging from the pole outside the gallery railing, in the middle left of the picture just left of her feet. In the attached picture its gold emblem is a vertical staff with a crossbar near the top and a fork at the bottom, which reads as a cross. Redraw that emblem as the same gold three-pronged trident as on the banner on the right: one straight shaft with three short upright prongs at the top, no crossbar. The banner keeps its colour, its torn edges and its place.

s20_f_godren.see: 核对过属实：他朝左、身子三分之二侧向我们，画面右上那只大手是他的左手，可画成了手背朝外、拇指在左边的右手；画面中上偏左、远一点那只是他的右手，画成了手背朝外、拇指在右边的左手。两只手互换，属人体错。骨戒照口径不论，改手时顺手挪到右手中指。用手撑不是用背顶、背骨的人朝哪边爬，不抠。
s20_f_godren.keep: the same composition and low camera, the slim purple-haired demon bonesmith with curled pale horns in the right half of the picture, kneeling and bracing with both arms raised under the cracked pale bone arch, his teeth clenched, his torn shirt and leather apron, the glowing blue threads running from his fingers around the arch, the blood on his fingertips and forearms, the leather wrist cuffs, the carrier crawling with a huge bone on his back on the left, the columns of white-red fire crashing down behind, the broken bone arches and the pack of dark wolves in the distance, the colours, rendering and finish.
s20_f_godren.change: his two hands pressed up against the underside of the arch. Both are seen from the back, fingers pointing up, fingertips dug into the stone. The big near hand at the upper right of the picture is his LEFT hand: redraw it so that, seen from the back, the thumb is on the RIGHT side of the hand as we look and the four fingers spread to the left of it, the little finger furthest left; it has no ring. The smaller far hand in the upper middle left of the picture, above his head, is his RIGHT hand: redraw it so that, seen from the back, the thumb is on the LEFT side of the hand as we look and the four fingers spread to the right of it, the little finger furthest right, with a plain empty bone ring on the middle finger. Both hands keep five digits, the same size, the same place at the ends of the same forearms with their leather cuffs, the same blood on the fingertips and the same blue threads.

s20_f_granto.see: 核对过：褪色的婴儿布条系在画面左边那只角上，场面稿写右角。布条系在哪只角照口径不改。别的看过：牛角巨人背影、双角顶在车头下、斧在脚边都对；上方攻城车的白色弯角贴在车身上，不贴天，不算月牙。

s20_f_ropes.see: 核对过属实：右半的死水魔神披着一件祭袍，胸口一道竖线加横梁、顶上一枚放射光芒的圆章，合起来是个大十字，袍身上一排方框里也都是小十字。场面稿写它是浑浊不流的死水聚成的人形、黑发像水草，图里身子半透明发绿、头发是水草状，只是多了这件带十字的祭袍，改袍子就行，局部改得动。
s20_f_ropes.keep: the same composition, the long-haired green-haired woman kneeling in the left foreground seen from behind, both arms stretched forward, the scales peeling off her bleeding arms, the arc of sea water pouring from her hands over into the glowing white ring of salt, the ring itself glowing like forge iron across the middle of the picture, the towering figure on the right with its long dark weed-like hair hanging down and its huge hands, the walls of waves on the dark sea behind, the small four-armed serpent woman on the far left, the colours, rendering and finish.
s20_f_ropes.change: the towering demon god in the right half of the picture. In the attached picture it wears a long ceremonial robe: a vertical line with a crossbar down the chest crowned by a glowing round sunburst medallion, which makes one big cross, and a row of square panels each holding a small cross down the hem, plus a glowing lattice orb at the top of the frame. Remove the robe and every one of those markings, the medallion and the lattice orb. Its body is made of murky, stagnant, greenish-brown water shaped like a giant: a translucent, faintly heaving surface with suspended silt and slime, no cloth, no seams, no symbols, no pattern, its long black waterweed hair hanging down over it in wet strands, its huge hands where they are now, its lower body still standing in the turbid pool inside the glowing salt ring, its head still cut off by the top of the frame.

s20_f_seola.see: 核对过属实：她黑外套前襟一排搭扣、腰下和下摆几处金属饰件都是小小的十字形。两臂张开是场面稿写的被影帘扯开，不算。
s20_f_seola.keep: the same composition and low camera, the slender mint-green-haired demon woman hanging in mid-air in the middle of the picture with both arms pulled wide, each hand gripping a fold of the vast black shadow curtain that is tearing into shreds, her face lifted into the shaft of white light falling from the rent at the top, the blood at the corner of her mouth, her long dark coat with red lining, torn hem and laced boots, the black strands sliding down past her, the dawn sky, the grey waste far below with the red-glowing encampments, the ruins and the small covered cart on the left, the colours, rendering and finish.
s20_f_seola.change: the small metal fastenings on her dark coat, in the middle of the picture. In the attached picture the row of clasps down the front of the coat, from the collar to the belt, and the several ornaments on the coat below the belt and on the skirts are each shaped like a small cross. Replace every one of them: the front of the coat is closed with plain round dark-metal buttons in a single straight row, and the ornaments below the belt become small plain round studs or short horizontal strap buckles. No cross shape anywhere on the coat.

s20_f_heban.see: 核对过属实：前景左下、下方当中、右下的骨片上刻着清楚的阿拉伯数字和字母样的记号（0、2、7、10一类）。另外右边敲钟那个灰皮人胸前挂的金饰是一个圆环加上下左右四根辐，像圆圈加十字，一起改。铜环套在哪只角照口径不改。上方那柄巨刃是一道长弧，是刃不是月牙，不改。
s20_f_heban.keep: the same composition and low camera, the white-haired muscular demon kneeling under the great cracked arch of the bone shield in the middle of the picture, his left arm thrust up against the inside of the shield, his clenched teeth, the blood running down his arm and side, the copper ring on his horn, his torn purple coat and grey trousers, the blue light cracking through the shield, the enormous glowing blade pressing down from the top of the frame, the gaunt grey-skinned man on the right striking a small bronze bell with rippling rings of sound, the stone platform, the flying bone splinters, the colours, rendering and finish.
s20_f_heban.change: Two things. First, the scattered bone plates lying on the stone ground in the lower left, lower middle and lower right foreground. In the attached picture they are carved with clear numerals and letter shapes like 0, 2, 7 and 10. Replace every carving with rough short scratches and notches, uneven tally-like gouges and chips that cannot be read as any digit or letter; the plates keep their shapes and places. Second, the gold ornament hanging on the chest of the grey-skinned bell ringer at the right edge. In the attached picture it is a ring with four spokes making a cross inside it. Change it to a plain round gold ring with a small hanging bone bead, no spokes and nothing inside the ring.

s20_f_dorgon.see: 核对过属实：他两条小臂外侧（画面当中偏左、抱着锤头的那两只胳膊上）各一块发白光的银白记号，画成了规整的 T 字形、像锤子图标，读着像字也像十字。
s20_f_dorgon.keep: the same composition and low camera from behind, the huge bronze-skinned bull-horned demon in the middle foreground facing away from us into the wall of water, legs braced wide and feet sunk in the wet sea floor, hugging the heavy iron hammer head in both bleeding hands and driving it into the root of the wave, the splintered hammer haft, his long golden hair and two horns, his leather smith's apron and torn cloth, the violet-white fire racing along the base of the wave, the towering black-green wave curling over the top of the frame, the glowing ring of salt with the small wounded figures on the right, the colours, rendering and finish.
s20_f_dorgon.change: the silver-white hammer burns on the outer side of both his forearms, in the middle left of the picture. In the attached picture each burn is a neat glowing T shape like a hammer icon, which reads as a letter or a cross. Replace each with an irregular, ragged patch of shiny silver-white scar tissue, a blotchy splash-shaped burn with uneven edges and a few smaller flecks around it, with no straight lines, no symmetry and no recognisable shape; the burns stay on the same two forearms in the same places, faintly glowing.

s20_f_ozga.see: 核对过：她身子压低往前冲、两手扒在烧白的岩面上，可头抬着、脸朝前，两只角往后弯、离前方的岩层还隔着一截，场面稿的那一下（低头把双角顶进岩层、整个人往上顶）没画出来。要低头、转角、让整个人往前顶，牵到头、颈、肩和姿势，局部改不过来。重画时顺手：长矛要插在她头顶上方六股熔岩汇成的那一潭里（图里插在左上远处的坡上），左角角根的金环缺一半。

s20_f_liko.see: 核对过属实：她的后背（脊沟、肩胛、开背的外套）、臀和靴底朝向镜头，是背面，脸却转成几乎四分之三正脸、两只眼都对着镜头，胸背打架；远侧那只脚踩在海岸地面上，人跟远处蹲着的人在同一高度，是站在岸上跨步，不是场面稿写的从下往上看、在高空里翻身用左翼推开最后一块落石，那一下没画出来。躯干朝向和人在空中的位置都要动，局部改不过来。

s20_f_darkai.see: 核对过：审稿人判过，记的两处（腐泥只到小腿没到腰，长剑画得偏短像短剑）照口径不抠。右手握剑、左腕流血都对，背影侧脸对。另看了一眼：右上魔神袍子上、旗上、酒罐上有放射状的太阳纹和多辐的圆轮，是多根光芒的日轮，不是圆圈加十字，没算进去；主会话要是也想收，可以另开一条把它们改成素面。
